::: {#def-map}
#### Maximum a posteriori estimate

The **maximum a posteriori** (MAP) estimate of a parameter $\theta$,
given observed data $\vY = \vy$,
written $\hth_{\text{MAP}}$,
is the value of $\theta$ that maximizes the [posterior density](#def-posterior):

$$\hth_{\text{MAP}} \eqdef \argmax_\theta \p(\theta \mid \vy)$$ {#eq-map}

The MAP estimate is the mode of the posterior distribution.
:::
